nepstest: Testing NEPS field data deliveries against the PV

Source: R/nepstest-package.R
nepstest-package.Rd

During the field period the survey institute sends field data deliveries (Stata .dta files). nepstest checks whether these data follow the programming templates (PVs, Programmiervorlagen). Every function tests one kind of tag of the PV and either prints SUCCESS or prints the problematic rows and caseids and stops with an error.

Which function for which tag:

PV tagWhat is testedFunction
ef-tagentry filter: item asked if and only if the condition holdsef_test()
ac-tagautocoding: variable has the expected valueac_test()
ra-tag (dates)date lies between two other datesdate_test_complex()
vb-tagvariable labelslabel_test()
we-tagvalue labels (codes and their labels)value_label_test()
af-tag (older PVs)exit filteraf_test_simple(), af_test_complex() (superseded)

read_pv() reads a PV docx file. Its result is needed for the label tests and is handy to look up the tags of an item.

Start with vignette("nepstest") for a complete walkthrough of a module check, and see vignette("label_test") for how the label tests work.
